story.titleZh: 勒克莱尔体验Eight Sleep新一代Pod 6产品
story.summaryZh: Eight Sleep发帖称，在Pod 6公开发布前，勒克莱尔曾到访其旧金山办公室试用产品并给出反馈，数月后公司向他展示了成品Pod 6。该内容主要为品牌宣传。

media.altZh: 勒克莱尔体验Eight Sleep新一代Pod 6产品 · 第 1 张

story.summaryEn:
👀Eight Sleep: Before Pod 6 was public, @charles_leclerc visited our San Francisco office to see what we were working on, test it for himself, and give us his honest feedback.
Months later, we got to show him the finished Pod 6. Six generations of learning, packed into our smallest Pod yet.
detailZh: Eight Sleep发文称：“在Pod 6公开发布之前，勒克莱尔到访了我们在旧金山的办公室，了解我们正在研发的产品，亲自试用，并给我们提供了他坦诚的反馈。数月之后，我们向他展示了完成的Pod 6。六代产品的积累，凝聚在我们迄今最小的Pod之中。”
detailEn:
👀Eight Sleep: Before Pod 6 was public, @charles_leclerc visited our San Francisco office to see what we were working on, test it for himself, and give us his honest feedback.
Months later, we got to show him the finished Pod 6. Six generations of learning, packed into our smallest Pod yet.
